Plot term effects for a fitted `gamlss.longitudinal` object

Source: R/common_functions.R
plot.terms.Rd

This is the original term-wise plotting behavior (smooth and fixed effects) that was previously exposed through `plot.gamlss.longitudinal()`.

Usage

plot.terms(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted `gamlss.longitudinal` object.

...

Additional arguments (currently unused).

y

Unused; included for S3 generic compatibility.

data

Optional data frame containing original covariates used to infer smooth-term x-axis variables. If omitted, smooth terms may fall back to index.

ci_level

Confidence level for pointwise intervals (default: 0.95).

ncol

Number of columns in each plot frame (default: 2).

include_intercept

Logical; include intercept terms in fixed plots.

ci_col

Color for confidence bands (default: "red").

fit_col

Color for fitted lines (default: "black").

show_legend

Logical; if TRUE, draw a legend in each panel.

smooth_even_grid

Logical; if TRUE, draw smooth terms on an evenly spaced x-grid.

smooth_grid_n

Number of x-grid points for smooth-term plots when `smooth_even_grid = TRUE`.

paginate

Logical; if `TRUE`, render one chart at a time and prompt for Enter between plots (interactive sessions). If `FALSE` (default), render all plots in a multi-panel dashboard.

Value

Invisibly returns a list with `smooth_terms` and `fixed_terms`.
